opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £10,000 to £250,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations, private owners of a heritage asset and partnerships. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, supporting projects that value, care for and sustain heritage. Open all year round with no deadline. Covers activities such as volunteer expenses, staff posts, capital works, conservation, professional fees and acquisition of heritage.

opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10million
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations and partnerships led by not-for-profit organisations. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members not related or living at the same address. Applicants must first submit an Expression of Interest.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, with quarterly deadlines. Applications go through a development phase (up to two years) and a delivery phase (no more than five years). Requires a minimum partnership funding contribution (5% for grants under £1m, 10% for grants over £1m).
